summary: Verified all 4 fixes in UI batch 2 on the PRO account (mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321!) at mobile viewport 390x844. (1) RECEIPTS no longer black: opened tool e659d60a (Injector seal installer kit) → Documents tab → both receipt thumbnails are real images loaded via AppImage from /api/files/<id> (naturalWidth/Height 1280x2783 and 1280x2369, complete=true). Tapping receipt-thumb-0 opens the fullscreen lightbox which renders the receipt at 1024x1536 (complete=true) — confirmed actual image content, NOT a black box. (2) TAB re-tap no-op: with a framenavigated counter, tapping tab-home twice while on Dashboard produced nav_count=0; navigating to Inventory produced nav_count=1, then re-tapping tab-inventory twice produced nav_count=0; switching back to tab-home produced nav_count=1. Re-tap correctly does nothing. (3) WEB document preview: tapping doc-open-43fa6f97... (30 Bin Rack DIY Plans 3-4-24.pdf) opened the in-app viewer modal — pdf.js rendered pages at 1108x856 inline (NOT auto-download). doc-viewer-close closes cleanly (testID disappears). (4) KeyboardProvider stability: app loads, login works, dashboard/inventory/tool-detail render, opening tool-menu-btn → menu-edit shows the EDIT form with 10 input fields and edit-save-bar / edit-cancel-bar both present; programmatically appended a character to the Item Name field and cancel-bar exited edit mode cleanly. No red screen, no JS pageerror, no fatal console errors (only the expected 401 retries from anonymous /api/files probes during auth bootstrap, which AppImage then re-fetches authenticated).
